title: Deploying VPN Service Edges in China

blocks.text: Private Access (ZPA) supports deploying a VPN Service Edge in Beijing, China, for specific use cases. Before configuring this deployment, review the following supported and unsupported scenarios.
VPN Service Edge in China is only supported when all the following conditions are met:

blocks.item: The user is located in China.
The user connects to the VPN Service Edge in China.
The is deployed in China and establishes an outbound connection to the VPN Service Edge in China.
The target application is hosted in China and serviced by the in China.

blocks.text: The following configurations are not supported:

blocks.item: Users located outside of China cannot connect to applications in China via the VPN Service Edge in China.
Users located in China cannot access applications hosted outside of China via the VPN Service Edge.

blocks.text: Do not configure unsupported scenarios. Configurations that violate these requirements are subject to the Zscaler Acceptable Use Policy. Zscaler reserves the right to delete any VPN Service Edge in China that violates these terms.
